lead_fa: بازی Destruction Warlock ضربه‌های بزرگ [[Chaos Bolt]] و کِلیو قدرتمند [[Havoc]] است: شاردهای تو به 10 تکه تقسیم می‌شوند و خرجشان بین [[Chaos Bolt]] تک‌هدف و [[Rain of Fire]] AoE دست خودت است. امضای اسپک [[Summon Infernal]] است. دو مسیر Hero Tree داری: [[Hellcaller]] که [[Immolate]] را به [[Wither]] تبدیل می‌کند و برچسب Best منبع را در تک‌هدف و کِلیو و Council و Delves دارد، و [[Diabolist]] که با احضار شیطان‌ها در روتیشن عادی دمیج اضافه می‌دهد و برچسب Best آن در Mythic+/AoE است.

raid_strengths: Good mobility when playing with Shadowburn
Decent defensives against burst damage with Unending Resolve and Dark Pact
Good utility: Create Soulwell, Demonic Gateway, Soulstone and Ritual of Summoning
mplus_strengths: Great priority target swap damage for new adds
Great sustained AoE damage on big pulls where mobs live longer
No diminishing returns on AoE: equal power with each additional target, making it one of the most potent AoE sources in the game
Good utility: Create Soulwell, Demonic Gateway and Soulstone
mplus_weaknesses: Weaker on smaller pulls because of a longer ramp time than other specs
No burst AoE compared to specs like Demonology

buffs: New talents: Chaotic Inferno, Alythess's Ire, Destructive Rapidity, Xorothian Research, Practiced Chaos, Improved Havoc, Lake of Fire and the Apex talent Embers of Nihilam
Roaring Blaze redesigned: spreads Immolate on up to 3 targets when casting Conflagrate
Shadowburn redesigned: only usable below 20% HP, cooldown removed and shard cost reduced to 1
Blistering Atrophy now increases Shadowburn Critical Strike chance to 100%
Dimensional Rift is now a passive giving your single-target spenders a chance to summon a dimensional rift
Soul Fire is now a choice node with Dimensional Rift
Avatar of Destruction redesigned: a chance to summon an Overfiend instead of the Dimensional Rift portal, or whenever you cast Soul Fire
Conflagration of Chaos redesigned: allows Shadowburn regardless of the target's HP and guarantees a Critical Strike scaling with your crit chance
nerfs: Removed talents: Eradication, Decimation, Power Overwhelming, Burn to Ashes, Devastation, Dimension Ripper, Indiscriminate Flames, Master Ritualist, Ritual of Ruin, Rolling Havoc and Pyrogenics
changes_12_1.note: Destruction has been stripped down quite a bit: you no longer maintain as many damage debuffs as before.

hero.recommendation: Hellcaller carries the Best tags for Single Target, Raid Cleave, Raid Council and Delves while Diabolist carries the Best tag for Mythic+/AoE. Hellcaller changes Immolate into Wither and interacts with that DoT for extra damage and self-buffs, strong on spread cleave and heavy AoE where you can apply Wither with Cataclysm. Diabolist deals extra damage from passively summoning demons through the regular rotation whenever you spend Soul Shards. The playstyle does not change a lot between the two and the talent builds are quite similar.
hero.hellcaller: Changes Immolate into Wither and further interacts with this DoT to deal extra damage and buff your own character; strong on spread cleave and heavy AoE.
hero.diabolist: Deals extra damage from summoning demons passively through the regular rotation whenever you spend Soul Shards; carries the Best tag for Mythic+/AoE.
hero.comparison_source_note: Wowhead overview and talent page (updated 2026-10-13): Hellcaller Best for Single Target, Raid Cleave, Raid Council and Delves; Diabolist Best for Mythic+/AoE.

concepts: Soul Shard management: Destruction shards are split into 10 fragments each; do not overcap and make sure you have shards when you need them
Cooldown management: properly managing Havoc and Summon Infernal, with the correct shard counts before them and no lost uses, separates high DPS from low DPS
Movement: only a few ways to deal damage while moving; cast Conflagrate on the run and use Demonic Circle and Demonic Gateway to minimize lost casts
A relatively simple spec that generates Soul Shards and spends them on big hits; the shard system with 10 fragments per shard plays differently from Affliction and Demonology
st_priority: Cast Shadowburn when available and if you are about to cap on soul shards
Cast Chaos Bolt to avoid capping soul shards
Cast Soul Fire when available and you have less than 4 soul shards
Cast Conflagrate to keep it below 2 stacks or when moving
Cast Conflagrate to generate soul shards and Backdraft stacks; use those on Chaos Bolt as much as possible
Cast Incinerate to generate soul shards
rotation.diabolist_st_note: As Diabolist the list plays Immolate instead of Wither; the rest of the priority is the same.
aoe_priority: Maintain Wither on as many targets as possible (Hellcaller) or Immolate on your main target plus any target expected to live longer than 10 seconds (Diabolist)
Cast Malevolence when you have as many enemies affected by Wither as possible (Hellcaller)
Spend your soul shards to avoid overcapping: Chaos Bolt on single targets and Rain of Fire in AoE
Make sure you have no more than 2 soul shards before casting Infernal Bolt
Cast Conflagrate to generate soul shards and Backdraft stacks
Cast Incinerate to generate soul shards
rotation.aoe_note: Destruction has no diminishing returns on AoE: each additional target gives equal power, making it one of the most potent AoE sources in the game on big pulls.

cooldowns.Summon Infernal: Signature cooldown; pop it with potions, trinkets and racials in the opener and always cast it manually since the rotation assistant does not highlight it
cooldowns.Havoc: Cleave engine that copies your single-target spells onto a second target; manage its cooldown together with Summon Infernal

rotation.hero_notes: The playstyle does not change much between Hellcaller and Diabolist: Hellcaller plays Malevolence and Wither while Diabolist keeps Immolate; the rotation assistant losses are about 3.8% single target and 11% AoE (or 10.4%/14% single-button) when you still remember to cast Summon Infernal manually.
opener: Pop Summon Infernal as well as any potions, trinkets and racials
Cast Malevolence to stack up your Wither (Hellcaller)
Cast Conflagrate to get it on cooldown and generate soul shards and Backdraft stacks
Generate and spend as many soul shards as possible during your cooldowns and dump all cooldown charges
Proceed onto the normal priority list
pre_combat: Get your food buff and oil applied
Cast Create Soulwell so every party or raid member can grab a Healthstone
Place your portals as needed: personal Demonic Circle and group Demonic Gateway
Double check your talents for the boss ahead

gear.gearing_rules: Destruction likes all stats fairly equally with some preference towards Haste and Critical Strike; stats are close enough that item level is effectively your best stat. Priority: Intellect > Haste > Mastery >= Critical Strike > Versatility for both heroes. Sim with Raidbots.

tier_set.note: 2pc: Incinerate damage increased by 25% and Incinerate has a 10% increased chance to evoke an Echo of Sargeras. 4pc: targets damaged by Echo of Sargeras take 6% increased damage from your spells and abilities for 6 seconds; most of the set's power sits behind the stacking 4-piece.

stats.cheatsheet: Intellect > Haste > Mastery >= Critical Strike > Versatility; identical for Hellcaller and Diabolist; stats are close enough that item level is effectively your best stat.
notes: Intellect is your primary stat on cloth gear and increases spell power.
Mastery makes your spells deal additional damage by a set percentage plus a random extra amount up to an equal percentage.
Destruction likes all stats fairly equally with some preference towards Haste and Critical Strike.

mplus.hero_note: Diabolist carries the Best tag for Mythic+/AoE this season while Hellcaller carries the rest; on big pulls Destruction has no diminishing returns on AoE and gains equal power per target, one of the most potent AoE sources in the game.
tips: On big pulls spend shards on Rain of Fire without worrying about AoE caps
Weave Havoc onto priority targets for swap damage on new adds
Shadowburn below 20% HP funds extra shards (cost reduced to 1 with no cooldown)
Conflagrate keeps Backdraft stacks for Chaos Bolt while giving movement casts
Demonic Circle and Demonic Gateway minimize the movement DPS loss on longer travels
